# Bases

_Generated from PoB tree data `3.29`. Regenerate after any data update - this script
rebuilds `bases.db` too._

Every equippable base in the game, with the numbers that decide which one is best
for a slot: 1009 rows, one per base. A base may be built on IF AND ONLY IF it has a
row - 87 bases removed from the game, 8 hidden bases and 2 statless weapon
placeholders are excluded at generation. Query
before naming a base; a remembered name is a hypothesis, and PoB's own base list
is not the answer - it still offers every base GGG has ever shipped.

**Scope: bases, not mods.** A row says the base exists, what it is worth, and which
influences it accepts. It says nothing about which affixes can roll on it - that is
spawn weight, and `tools/affixes.lua "<base>"` is the only answer. Never infer a
mod pool from `base_tags`.

## Querying bases.db

Run `sqlite3` with paths from the repo root (from `src/`, prefix `../`). Names are
exactly what goes in an item's base line, parentheses included: `Two-Stone Ring
(Fire/Cold)`. Double any apostrophe inside SQL strings.

- `bases(id, name, class, subtype, slot, req_level, req_str, req_dex, req_int,
  socket_limit, one_hand, melee, implicit, can_be_anointed, armour_min, armour_max,
  evasion_min, evasion_max, es_min, es_max, ward_min, ward_max, block_chance,
  movement_penalty, phys_min, phys_max, crit_chance, attack_rate, phys_dps, range,
  flask_life, flask_mana, flask_duration, flask_charges_used, flask_charges_max,
  tincture_mana_burn, tincture_cooldown)` - `class` is the item class
  (`Body Armour`, `Bow`, `Jewel`); `slot` is the primary equipment slot PoB puts it
  in. Requirements are 0, never NULL, when the base has none. Every stat column is
  NULL when the column does not apply to that class - filter on `IS NOT NULL`, not
  on `> 0`. `implicit` is the joined implicit text for eyeballing; query
  `base_mods` for structure.
- `base_tags(base_id, tag)` - GGG's base tags (`str_armour`, `two_hand_weapon`,
  `talisman`). Identity only. NOT a mod pool.
- `base_influences(base_id, influence, mod_tag)` - one row per influence the base
  accepts (`shaper`, `elder`, `adjudicator`, `basilisk`, `crusader`, `eyrie`,
  `cleansing`, `tangle`); `mod_tag` is what `affixes.lua --<influence>` looks up. No
  rows = the base cannot be influenced at all.
- `base_mods(id, base_id, scope, ord, line, template, affix_id, types)` - scope
  `implicit|enchant|flask_buff`; `line` keeps ranges (`+(20-30) to Strength`);
  `template` is the line with every number/range as `#` - LIKE-match on it, not on
  `line`; `affix_id` is GGG's mod id; `types` is the space-joined mod-type tags.
- `base_mod_values(mod_id, ord, min, max)` - a line's numbers in reading order;
  fixed values have min = max. Numeric criteria go here, never regex on `line`.
- `legacy_bases(name, class)` - the bases excluded as unobtainable, so a remembered
  name resolves to "removed from the game" instead of silence. NOT usable.
- `meta(key, value)` - `tree_version`, `generated_at`, `legacy_bases`.

Canonical queries:

```sh
DB=.claude/skills/cook/data/bases.db
# existence + slot - zero rows means DO NOT USE, whatever the reason
sqlite3 $DB "SELECT class, subtype, slot, req_level FROM bases WHERE name='Vaal Regalia';"
# best base of a type: highest ES body armour wearable at 95
sqlite3 $DB "SELECT name, es_max, req_int FROM bases WHERE class='Body Armour'
  AND es_max IS NOT NULL AND req_level<=95 ORDER BY es_max DESC LIMIT 5;"
# best weapon: top physical DPS one-handers that are not Sceptres
sqlite3 $DB "SELECT name, class, phys_dps, crit_chance, attack_rate FROM bases
  WHERE one_hand=1 AND class<>'Sceptre' ORDER BY phys_dps DESC LIMIT 10;"
# fastest bases for a trigger build, crit-viable
sqlite3 $DB "SELECT name, class, attack_rate, crit_chance FROM bases
  WHERE attack_rate IS NOT NULL AND crit_chance>=6.5 ORDER BY attack_rate DESC LIMIT 10;"
# implicit search: bases whose implicit gives +1 to a gem level
sqlite3 $DB "SELECT b.name, b.class, m.line FROM base_mods m JOIN bases b ON b.id=m.base_id
  WHERE m.scope='implicit' AND m.template LIKE '%to Level of all % Skill Gems%';"
# influence check before authoring a shaper mod
sqlite3 $DB "SELECT i.influence, i.mod_tag FROM base_influences i
  JOIN bases b ON b.id=i.base_id WHERE b.name='Hubris Circlet';"
# a name that returns nothing: ask whether it USED to exist
sqlite3 $DB "SELECT class FROM legacy_bases WHERE name='Imbued Wand';"
```

## What min and max mean

The two families of range column are NOT the same measurement.

- **Weapons** - `phys_min`/`phys_max` are the damage roll of a hit, both real. The
  ranking number is `phys_dps` = `(phys_min+phys_max)/2 * attack_rate`, stored
  rounded to 2dp so it can be sorted directly. It is base physical only: no quality,
  no affixes, no added elemental.
- **Armour** - `armour_min`..`armour_max` (and evasion / ES / ward) is a variance
  band on the base defence stat, not two separate stats. `Item.lua:2340` applies
  `min + variance * (percentile or 1)`, so an item you author with no percentile set
  gets **`*_max`** - the 100th-percentile base. Compare bases on `*_max` and the
  build measures what it compares.

Quality multiplies both families (20% quality = 20% more base defence, or 20% more
base physical on a weapon) and is applied after the base value, so it never changes
which base wins within a class.

## Classes

`slot` is the primary slot; a second copy goes in the paired slot where one exists
(`Ring 2`/`Ring 3`, `Weapon 2`, `Flask 2..5`). `influenced` counts bases in the

## Removed bases

PoB has no obtainability flag on bases the way it does on uniques - `Data/Bases/*.lua`
is every base GGG ever shipped, and a removed one looks exactly like a live one in the
UI, the base dropdown and the parser. The only signal is poewiki's `drop_enabled`, so
it is frozen into `data/legacy-bases.tsv` and this script reads that file offline;
87 PoB bases are excluded by it. Bases the wiki has no row for at all are named
one by one in the fetch tool's `NO_WIKI_ROW` table - absence from a wiki is evidence
of nothing, so each is a recorded call. Anything in neither place is KEPT and
reported, so new PoB data surfaces loudly instead of vanishing.

Refresh the tsv with `tools/fetch-legacy-bases.lua` (the only tool here that needs
network) after a PoB base-data update. Nothing else re-queries the wiki.

## Traps

- **A Talisman costs you the anoint.** All 43 surviving Talisman bases ship a fixed
  `enchant`-scope mod instead and carry `can_be_anointed = 0`; the 18 plain amulets
  anoint normally. The Talismans that did anoint are the ones 3.29 removed, so a
  half-remembered "talisman with an implicit" is a legacy base - check
  `legacy_bases`. Read the flag rather than the subtype; it is NULL off amulets,
  where anointing does not exist.
- **Thrusting swords are One Handed Swords.** `class` says `One Handed Sword` and
  `subtype` says `Thrusting`; GGG treats the class as identical for weapon
  restrictions (`CalcPerform.lua:226`), so a skill that wants a sword takes one. The
  subtype only matters for the dual-wield same-class check.
- **Grafts are not in the game** - a 3.27 league mechanic, removed in 3.28. They are
  in `legacy_bases` like any other removed base, but they get their own note because
  PoB carries a full Graft mod pool and two Graft slots as well: it hides the slots
  (`ItemsTab.lua:166`) and drops graft items from calcs (`CalcSetup.lua:703`) on any
  tree but 3.27, so on the 3.29 tree a graft parses fine and measures as nothing.
- **No `base_influences` rows means no influence, ever** - jewels, flasks and
  tinctures have none. One Exarch + one Eater implicit remains a separate axis with
  its own rules: `influences.md`.
- **`socket_limit` is the ceiling, not a promise** - a 6-link needs a base with
  `socket_limit = 6`, which is body armours and two-handed weapons only. NULL means
  the class takes no sockets.
- **Jewel bases live here too**, but what a jewel DOES to the tree - cluster
  mechanics, timeless conquests, radius transformers - is `jewels.md`. This db only
  says which jewel bases exist and what they socket into.
